items.title: Frank Tiberi interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, May 30, 2022
items.q: It was Urbie Green that took the band out on the road, with the Benny Goodman band.

ctx.x: Was he as absent minded as many of those stories indicate?

Well you know at that stage of the game I think he was a little old then, he wasn’t just as great as he was actually. But I mean it was only like the concert that we had around — it was an outside concert with the group, with a small group, we had a couple of concerts with the small group and the band also. But after that he didn’t really attend too much. It was Urbie Green that took the band out on the road, with the Benny Goodman band.
And how much playing are you doing yourself these days?
